set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWZ2GPT8TQV4J75CBXYKHT0S. Scope: turn rank-deficient OLS behavior into an explicit ADT policy rather than implicit reject-only behavior. Candidate modes: strict full-rank rejection, estimable/aliased-column diagnostics, ridge policy, or future minimum-norm solve. Acceptance: public API names the chosen behavior; unsupported modes fail explicitly; rank-deficient tests pin the semantics on JVM and JS.
set.title: LS hardening: make rank-deficient semantics explicit
